reply.text:
I'm sorry you're feeling that way about how you look. Skipping meals to lose weight isn't something I'll build a plan around, and I'm not going to give you a fat-burning plan on top of it. That's one to talk through with a doctor or a registered dietitian, who can help you with both the eating and how you're feeling about your body.

Once you've done that, I'm glad to help with the training side: getting stronger, building a routine you enjoy, and getting back into a rhythm. We start from wherever you are.
